title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Is it possible to change the Variant Code for an item that has already been posted?
summary: Changing a variant code for an already-posted item in Business Central requires workarounds since item reclassification journals don't support variant changes. Two feasible solutions are using Item Journals for negative and positive adjustments, or using Assembly Orders to transfer quantities between variants.
key_points: Item variants help manage similar products with different attributes like color without creating separate items
Item Reclassification Journals cannot change variant codes because variants are treated as distinct items in the system
Use Item Journals with negative adjustments on the original variant and positive adjustments on the target variant
Assembly Orders can also transfer inventory between variants by specifying the source variant in lines and target variant in posting details
